violations.text: Several items in the buffet line cold well were observed held at 37-63 degrees Fahrenheit (see temperatures). Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Food items observed at 45 degrees or higher were voluntarily disposed of by the PIC at the time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Food items set for self-selection do not have ingredient information available for customer viewing. Establishment is to provide a sign/placard making customers aware that ingredients for all items set for self-selection are available upon request. New Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

Several dry food items on the customer self-service buffet line were observed held in containers lacking lids/protection from possible contamination. Consumer self-service operations for READY-TO-EAT FOODS shall be provided with suitable UTENSILS or effective dispensing methods that protect the FOOD from contamination. Per the PIC, proper equipment is on order for the buffet line. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 09/21/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the kitchen oven (internal surfaces) were observed to have an accumulation of food residue/grease. Equipment is to be cleaned as often as necessary to keep clean and preclude the buildup of soil/debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/25/2026

The cold well drain to the buffet line refrigeration unit is lacking a proper drain and set for dripping into a pan. Condensate drainage and other non-sewage liquids must properly drain. Maintenance personnel on site at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 10/05/2026

Pitchers of raw egg product were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods in the 2 Door Reach-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Raw egg product to be stored on the bottom shelf. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2025

Pastry items were observed displayed for customer self-selection on the buffet line without protection from possible contamination. FOOD on display shall be protected from contamination by the use of PACKAGING (wrapped individually); use of a counter, service line, or salad bar FOOD guard; display case; or other effective means. New Violation. Correct By: 10/01/2025
